thread:
Megan: quick sync — Prospect Orbit has a firm ask: private deployment by EoQ with SLA 99.95% and p95 <140ms for chat. They also want KMS with HSM option, 12mo audit retention, and a safe canary plan. Need cross-team tradeoffs and owners. who can own the scope map?

Arman: I can take runtime sequencing + perf plan. need traffic shape (steady qps vs onboarding spikes) and expected prompt distributions to pick batching/kv strategies.

Megan: steady ~85 qps, onboarding bursts up to 600 qps for short bursts. median prompt ~120 tokens, 99th ~1100 tokens. they will tolerate documented fallback for up to 0.2% of requests.

Kelsey: infra note: dedicated pool in Orbit VPC is doable. main decision: prewarmed nodes vs rapid-attach standby. prewarm reduces tail but costs baseline. need runtime cold-start target to recommend.

Priya: security essentials: KMS + optional HSM, VPC peering, SAML/SCIM, and 12mo retention. Legal flagged the need for a PII redaction mapping. threat model signoff required before private control-plane access.

Arman: perf quick take: steady p95 likely achievable with 6-8xA100-equivalent depending on quantization; tails will need autoscale with ~40s scale-up unless prewarmed nodes are used. i'll prototype batching windows and kv-prefetch patterns this week.

Ruben: solutions perspective: Orbit plans a heavy data import day during onboarding. can we schedule a controlled maintenance window for that to avoid SLA exposure? if yes, it makes acceptance easier.

Megan: proposed rollout (draft):
1) Contract gating: privacy addendum + SLO appendix + maintenance window agreement
2) Staging validation: perf + security checklist (10 days)
3) Canary: 5% traffic -> 20% over 72h with strict rollback triggers and SLO tags
4) Progressive ramp with 7-day stability hold before GA

Kelsey: infra action items:
- cost delta for prewarm (0/4/8 prewarm nodes) vs standby attach (by Thu EOD)
- reserve staging cluster "orbit-stg-1777" with 4 prewarm slots (pending billing)
- implement fast-attach automation for standby nodes (P1)

Priya: security action items:
- KMS/HSM integration plan (owner: Priya)
- PII redaction mapping draft for legal (Priya + Legal)
- threat model and access plan by next Tue

Arman: runtime action items:
- perf matrix + test harness (deliverable: perf-matrix.md by Fri)
- define runtime cold-start SLA required from infra (e.g., <12s)
- fallback variant integration tests and observability (SLO tags + error-budget alerts)

Ruben: customer coordination:
- confirm maintenance window for heavy imports (owner: Ruben)
- sign-off on fallback behavior and rollback contacts

Megan: owners recap: Megan (PM), Arman (runtime), Kelsey (infra), Priya (security), Ruben (customer lead).

Quick ask: each owner drop a 3-bullet checklist in this thread by EOD tomorrow. i'll consolidate and share with Orbit legal and infra.

deploy-bot: staging cluster "orbit-stg-1777" created by Kelsey at 2025-11-20T16:07:12Z — 4 prewarm slots allocated. :rocket:

Arman: will post perf matrix tonight. early hypothesis: quantized model + 6 GPUs + continuous-batching + KV-prefetch hits steady p95; bursts need a small prewarm buffer or faster attach. :eyes:

Kelsey: noted. i'll include attach latencies in the cost doc. if runtime needs <8s cold-start we'll plan for 6 prewarmed nodes.

Priya: pinging legal: @legal need guidance on PII controls for 12mo audit retention (finance vs infra data).

Megan: thanks team. flag blockers here. planning a 15-min sync tomorrow if checklists appear. :calendar:
